Title: Ventilation strategies in acute respiratory distress syndrome
Abstract: Patients with acute respiratory distress syndrome required mechanical ventilation. Lung recruitment improved oxygenation in ventilated patients with severe respiratory failure.

Title: Lung failure in critically ill coronavirus patients
Abstract: Acute lung injury and respiratory failure were observed in critically ill patients. Mechanical ventilation was required for severe hypoxaemia.

Title: Inhaled nitric oxide for severe hypoxaemia
Abstract: Inhaled nitric oxide improved oxygenation in patients with severe respiratory failure and pulmonary hypertension during mechanical ventilation.

Title: Breathing difficulty assessment in outpatients
Abstract: Breathing difficulty and shortness of breath were assessed in outpatients recovering from coronavirus infection. Pulmonary function was measured.

Title: Vaccine immunogenicity in healthy adult volunteers
Abstract: The vaccine produced antibody seroconversion in healthy adult volunteers. Immune response was measured by neutralising antibody titre after two doses.

Title: Antibody response after second vaccine dose
Abstract: Neutralising antibody levels increased after the second vaccine dose. Seroconversion occurred in most vaccinated participants.

Title: Immune response in immunocompromised vaccine recipients
Abstract: Vaccine immunogenicity was reduced in immunocompromised patients. Antibody titre remained low despite a third dose.

Title: Acute kidney injury among hospitalised patients
Abstract: Renal impairment and acute kidney injury occurred frequently in hospitalised patients. Dialysis was required in severe renal failure.

Title: Continuous renal replacement therapy outcomes
Abstract: Continuous renal replacement therapy was evaluated in patients with acute kidney injury and combined renal failure requiring dialysis.

Title: Kidney function recovery after critical illness
Abstract: Renal function recovery was assessed after critical illness. Persistent kidney impairment was common among dialysis-dependent patients.

Title: Anticoagulation for thrombosis prophylaxis
Abstract: Anticoagulation with heparin reduced thrombosis and pulmonary embolism in hospitalised patients with elevated coagulation markers.

Title: Coagulation abnormalities in severe infection
Abstract: Coagulation abnormalities and elevated D-dimer predicted thrombosis risk. Heparin prophylaxis was administered to hospitalised patients.

Title: Corticosteroid therapy in severe inflammation
Abstract: Corticosteroid therapy reduced systemic inflammation and mortality in patients with severe disease requiring oxygen supplementation.

Title: Anti-inflammatory treatment for cytokine response
Abstract: Anti-inflammatory treatment targeted the cytokine response. Interleukin blockade reduced inflammation markers in hospitalised patients.

Title: Antiviral therapy in early infection
Abstract: Early antiviral therapy reduced viral load in outpatients. Treatment was administered within five days of symptom onset.

Title: Viral load kinetics during treatment
Abstract: Viral load declined after antiviral treatment. Nasopharyngeal swab samples were collected to measure viral clearance.

Title: Anxiety and emotional eating during the pandemic
Abstract: Coronavirus anxiety levels and emotional eating behaviour were assessed in individuals with metabolic syndrome and healthy controls.

Title: Mental health outcomes in healthcare workers
Abstract: Anxiety and depression symptoms were measured among healthcare workers. Psychological distress increased during the pandemic period.

Title: Rehabilitation after prolonged hospitalisation
Abstract: Physical rehabilitation improved functional capacity after prolonged hospitalisation. Exercise tolerance was measured at twelve weeks.

Title: Long-term symptoms following acute infection
Abstract: Persistent fatigue and breathlessness were reported months after acute infection. Symptom duration was recorded in a follow-up cohort.
